harness: AgentDojo 0.1.35 (README/paper: pip install agentdojo==0.1.35; every log records 0.1.35 per phase-10c census), installation not pinned in the repo (no lockfile). Two entry points: (1) agentdojo.scripts.benchmark --model LOCAL (Phase 0/1: results/p1-*, runs*, pipeline_name 'local', benchmark default v1.2.2); (2) src/run_defended.py (all other dirs, --benchmark-version default v1.2, pipeline_name 'local-<model>-gate-<arm>[-echo]', 'local' prefix forced so important_instructions resolves the model name to AgentDojo's 'Local model'). Providers: Ollama via LocalLLM (32k arms) and Venice via OpenAILLM behind a request-sanitising proxy that sets include_venice_system_prompt=false (480b and ladder arms); 'venice-prompt' LocalLLM path for Hermes-text models. Defences: PolicyGate (src/defenses/policy_gate.py, versions v1, v2, v3, v3.1 all under label gate-all) and GatellmGate (gatellml runtime; auto-manifest and hand manifests v1/v2/v3 under label gate-gatellm), optional AnswerEchoFilter (-echo). Both gates strip blocked calls from the assistant message and append error tool results (PolicyGate 'BLOCKED by security policy: <rule>...', GatellmGate 'BLOCKED by security policy (<rule>)...'; corrected in fact-check). Known AgentDojo 0.1.35 issues relevant here: LocalLLM drops fenced tool calls (#202), keeps only the first call (#150), drops calls with empty body/trailing text (#219), turns server errors into an empty answer (#220); security_from_traces counts proposed calls (#189 closed, #168 slack inj5); slack utility KeyError when post_webpage does not execute (#188); non-ASCII tool results as \uXXXX (#214); banking UserTask5 utility check (#161); workspace v1.2.2 discrimination question (#201).

Two benchmark versions: v1.2.2 in the 215 'local' logs (agentdojo.scripts.benchmark default) vs v1.2 elsewhere; the README compares p1 (v1.2.2) with p2 (v1.2) as one grid; v1.2.2 changes only workspace UserTask16 (in p1-benign, not in any attack grid) and banking UserTask6

Metric mapping differs by tool: README/STATE (src/aggregate.py) compute utility under attack over attacked + pre-pass files (59.1% = 91/154) but ASR over attacked files only; gatellml (suite_summary.py) uses attacked files only and excludes pre-pass ('calib'); the paper sometimes uses delivered-cell denominators (slack 0/10)

Census arithmetic: 1,616 security==true over 3,870 logs minus 1,491 benign constants = 125 attacked successes; the reported arms sum to 122 plus about 3 in v1-CONTAMINATED (STATE '5%'), which implies the unreported v5-frontier-fullgrid-gatev2 and v6-focused-gatev3 arms have 0 successes (fact-check: the unreported smoke-gatellm attacked cell is also implied 0; the v1-CONTAMINATED '3' rests on STATE's approximate '5%', so the v5/v6 = 0 inference is conditional)
